description: This Java source file defines the class SecurePayPaymentServices, which provides services for integrating with the SecurePay payment gateway. It includes methods for performing authorization, capture, void, refund, and credit operations, as well as utility methods for configuration. The code utilizes SecurePay's API classes and OFBiz's service utilities, indicating its role in payment processing within an OFBiz-based system.

classes.name: SecurePayPaymentServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to facilitate payment operations through the SecurePay gateway, including authorization, capture, void, refund, and credit transactions. It retrieves configuration properties, interacts with SecurePay API classes, and returns structured results for each operation.

methods.name: doAuth
methods.description: Performs an authorization transaction with SecurePay, preparing and sending payment details, then returns authorization results including approval status, reference number, and messages.

methods.name: ccReAuth
methods.description: Stub method for credit card re-authorization; currently returns success without implementation.

methods.name: doCapture
methods.description: Captures funds for a previously authorized transaction by sending capture request to SecurePay and returning the outcome including reference number and status.

methods.name: doVoid
methods.description: Voids (cancels) a previously authorized payment, returning success or failure based on SecurePay response.

methods.name: doRefund
methods.description: Issues a refund for a completed transaction to SecurePay, returning details on success or failure.

methods.name: doCredit
methods.description: Processes a credit operation, such as a refund or pre-authorization reversal, with SecurePay and returns the result.

methods.name: buildScProperties
methods.description: Builds configuration properties for SecurePay API access, fetching values from payment gateway configurations or properties files.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves specific configuration values for SecurePay API, querying the database if a config ID is provided, or properties files otherwise.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Overloaded method providing default value support when fetching configuration.
